description_en: When an event is handled using response orchestration, the response center creates a task. Perform follow-up actions on the task, such as unblocking, retrying a block, and removing from isolation
description_zh: 用户在使用响应编排的功能进行事件处置时，处置中心会生成相应的处置任务，该接口用于对生成的处置任务执行后续的解除封禁、重试封禁、解除隔离等动作
name: TriggerProcessTask

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the handling task.

Call the [DescribeProcessTasks](~~DescribeProcessTasks~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
处置任务的唯一标识。
调用[DescribeProcessTasks](~~DescribeProcessTasks~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the handling action. Valid values:

remove: Removes a block or an asset from isolation.

retry: Resubmits the task
parameters.help_zh:
处置动作的类型，取值如下：

remove：表示解除封禁或隔离
retry：表示重新提交任务
parameters.name: action_type

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
